text:
maya: quick heads-up — Hummingbird SRE hitting weird SCIM failures on our POC. Bulk group updates returning mixed status. anyone on SCIM quirks?

andrew: seen this before with provider canonicalization mismatches. can you paste their response?

maya: they forwarded this; says 207 Multi-Status during /Groups bulk patch.

```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:BulkResponse"],
  "Operations": [
    {
      "method": "PATCH",
      "bulkId": "g-123",
      "status": 207,
      "response": {
        "status": 409,
        "detail": "member not found: Alice+alias@hummingbird.io"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

jordan: sales ask: they want domain-locking + tenant isolation. also want a clear POC price summary (hosted vs dedicated) and whether RBAC mapping can be done via SCIM groups.

andrew: domain-locking — we support assertion checks (NameID/email) plus domain verification list. typical approach: assert then enforce (reject) or audit-only mode. SCIM can tag resources with tenant_id and we enforce isolation server-side. RBAC: yes, map scim.groups -> app roles (example: `scim:group:eng-admins => role:admin`).

andrew: on the SCIM partial failure behavior: our runtime returns 207 for bulk with per-item statuses; we persist operation results in the tenant audit log and expose a retry endpoint for failed items. idempotency headers supported (`Idempotency-Key`).

chris: security clarifications to include: retention policy (default 365d), admin audit trail for SCIM operations, encryption at rest, KMS integration for Private deployments, and we do not auto-delete failed objects on partial errors.

maya: can someone draft a short preflight checklist I can send to their SRE before tomorrow's call? they asked for: SAML metadata, SCIM base URL + auth, subject format, example group mappings, peak QPS expectations, and list of admin delegates.

andrew: paste this to forward:
- SAML: metadata XML, entityID, ACS URL, NameID format (email or transient), sample attribute mappings (email, displayName, groups)
- SCIM: base URL, Bearer token auth, supported operations (GET/POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE), bulk size limit, idempotency header usage, error model (207 per-item statuses)
- RBAC mapping examples: `scim.groups:platform-admins -> role:admin`, `scim.groups:qa -> role:viewer`
- Domain controls: verified domains list, enforcement mode: `audit` | `enforce`
- Performance: expected peak QPS, average group size, acceptable tail latency for SAML (ms)
- Security: retention window, encryption/KMS details, contact for incident response

jordan: i've drafted a 4-week POC commercial: hosted trial w/ free credits to validate flows, optional single-week Dedicated burst for scale tests. conversion discount note if they sign within 45 days.

salesbot: Quote generated: https://redwood.example/quote/HB-9921 — checklist uploaded: https://redwood.example/pocexports/HB-9921-preflight.pdf

maya: please add a mitigation plan for the canonicalization issue and flag as potential blocker. they'll want an ops workaround during the POC.

andrew: mitigation bullets i'll add: 1) normalize inbound SCIM emails (lowercase, remove known alias patterns) 2) run preflight resolution step to verify members before applying bulk ops 3) on failure, surface unresolved members in a report and offer manual reconcile endpoint 4) estimate: 2 dev days + 1 day QA to add preflight and normalization to the SCIM handler.

chris: i'll prepare the security blurb about audit + retention and attach our SAML metadata handling note.

maya: great. i'll send the quote + checklist + this mitigation plan to Hummingbird SRE and loop back after their 9am PT call. :thumbsup:
